chapter_outcomes: Candidates must study a rural settlement (village or hamlet) or a rural area showing some of the issues of its development and growth (or decline) and evaluating the responses to these issues
Candidates must study urban settlements showing the challenges of, and evaluating the attempted solutions in a shanty town (squatter settlement) in an LIC or MIC
Candidates must study urban settlements showing the challenges of, and evaluating the attempted solutions in providing infrastructure (either power or transport) for a city.
